This proves the completed local ring without finite extrapolation. Independent nodal factors yield \(2^c\) branches and multiplicity \(2^c\); the conductor follows by recording monomials supported on a unique normalization branch. The 844-case exact Jacobian check matches the predicted tangent dimension. Distinct rank-one Segre cones and their support incidence yield the global normalization and the reduced singular locus. Jia--Li prove the original determinantal scheme is reduced; the origin is singular by its purely quadratic defining equations. The origin local ring and nonreduced Jacobian scheme are not claimed.

value.rationale: The natural zero-moment fibre of the minimal nilpotent orbit is known to be reduced and Gorenstein but its fine singularity geometry is a different invariant. The theorem gives all nonzero completed local rings, local conductor/branch/multiplicity information and an unbounded count of codimension-one singular components. The depth of nonnormal crossings varies with a canonical support statistic, providing useful information for normalization and boundary-gluing questions that neither Gorensteinness nor Hilbert series determines. The all-dimension classification is natural and not an arbitrary parameter slice.
